description: Apply two sequential filters to every comment returned by the polling loop before any other processing. First: discard comments where comment.user.login !== authenticatedUser (never inspect the body of foreign comments). Second: discard comments where new Date(comment.created_at) < lastPolled (ignore edits — GitHub since filters on updated_at, not created_at). Comments passing both filters proceed to trigger detection.
title: Comment filtering (created_at gate + authenticated-user gate)
